name: Indian Toners & Developers Limited
about: Indian Toners & Developers Limited manufactures and sells compatible toners in India. The company offers chemical color, laser, copier/digital, and wide format copier and printer toners. Its products are primarily used in laser, digital multi-function, and wide format printers, as well as digital machines and analogue copiers. The company provides its products under the ITDL Color Premium and Supremo brands through a network of jobbers, re-fillers, distributors, direct dealers, and wholesalers. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
